summary.text: Neal Tapio is an independent candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives, District 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and a former Republican state senator who represented District 5 from 2017 to 2019.

paragraphs.text: Tapio is a business owner and the president of NT Sales and Leasing, Inc., and he graduated from Moorhead State University.
Tapio was elected to the South Dakota State Senate from District 5 in 2016 as a Republican and took office on January 10, 2017.
In the 2017 session he served on the Commerce and Energy, Government Operations and Audit, and Health and Human Services committees, the last as vice chair.
In 2018 he sought the Republican nomination for South Dakota's at-large U.S. House seat and finished third in the June 5 primary with 23.9 percent of the vote.
